_leyenda: IMG-4: lo común a todos los prompts de Helek Sirik (Berig), en inglés porque entra tal cual. Lo explica docs/producto/plan-imagenes/guia-visual-mundo.md; lo usa image-generator/scripts/prompt_ficha.py. Las claves de _propuestas esperan la aprobación de la usuaria.

preambulo.dia: A grounded fantasy world with a physical, natural logic, where everything is handmade from wood, hide, bone, stone and dark iron. By day the sky is clear with a light warm haze, drifting dust catches the light, with deep aerial perspective and strong contrast. The mood is wild, quiet and lived-in, with vivid, saturated natural colours, deep shadows and glowing rim light. The image is completely textless.
preambulo.atardecer: A grounded fantasy world with a physical, natural logic, where everything is handmade from wood, hide, bone, stone and dark iron. At dusk the low sun sets the sky ablaze in saturated amber, orange and crimson, and thick drifting dust glows in the backlight, with deep aerial perspective and strong contrast. The mood is wild, quiet and lived-in, with long shadows, vivid, saturated warm colours and glowing rim light. The image is completely textless.
preambulo.noche: A grounded fantasy world with a physical, natural logic, where everything is handmade from wood, hide, bone, stone and dark iron. By night the sky is full of stars under a soft, even pearly glow. The mood is wild, quiet and lived-in, with deep cool shadows, muted natural colours and firelight as the only warm light. The image is completely textless.

estilos._nota: D8 (usuaria, 2026-10-25): banner realista, icono y thumbnail al óleo (thumbnail es icono), mapa a medio camino.

banner.base: Epic fantasy {clase} photograph, hyper-detailed and razor-sharp, dramatic rim lighting, volumetric dust, vivid saturated colours.

fauna.acabado: Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, ultra detailed fur, hide and scale texture.

flora.acabado: Shot with a 100mm macro lens, ultra detailed botanical and mineral texture.

location.acabado: Shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, deep focus, ultra detailed ground, grass and rock texture.

npc.acabado: Shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens, ultra detailed skin, fur and leather texture.

icono.base: Oil painting with visible brushstrokes and rich impasto, a single clear subject with a strong readable silhouette.

mapa.base: Painterly realism halfway between a photograph and an oil painting: realistic terrain, light and texture rendered with soft, visible brushwork.

encuadres.banner: Wide panoramic framing with open sky across the top sixth of the image, the subject slightly off-centre with room around it and the whole subject fully inside the frame.
encuadres.thumbnail: Close, centred framing of a single subject with clear space above the top of it and a plain, softly blurred background, so the silhouette still reads when small.
encuadres.icono: A single centred subject filling most of the frame on a plain, softly painted background.
encuadres.mapa: Empty terrain seen from straight above: ground, vegetation, paths and natural landmarks, the whole area in frame at one consistent scale and perspective.

Llanuras del Viento Rojo.paisaje: a vast red clay steppe with tufts of dry straw-yellow grass tinged with orange, scattered savanna scrub and low volcanic peaks far off in the haze, fine red dust drifting on the wind

luz.dia: Low sun just above the horizon through a haze of red dust throws a warm golden rim light.
luz.atardecer: A large low sun sinks into the red dust haze, staining the sky amber and deep rose and stretching long violet shadows across the plain.
luz.noche: Stars shine in a clear sky over the plain, a soft, even pearly glow lights the red dust and the grass tips, and the shadows are deep and cool.

estaciones.primavera: Seasonal floods fill the dry watercourses and the hollows with shallow brown water, and fresh green shoots show among the straw-yellow grass tinged with orange.
estaciones.verano: The dry season has cracked the red clay and parched the grass to brittle straw-yellow tinged with orange, leaving the watercourses as pale empty beds.
estaciones.otono: It is the harvest season: the grass stands tall and heavy with seed, low plants bear ripe fruit among the tufts, and long files of migrating animals cross the plain.
estaciones.invierno: The long season has flattened and thinned the grass, which lies pale straw-yellow tinged with orange over bare red clay, and a cold wind sweeps the plain under a low pale sky.

Cristal Helado.paisaje: high ice-capped mountains above a tundra of dark volcanic rock patched with snow, glaciers and sheer sea cliffs

luz.dia: Pale low arctic sun, cold blue shadows and crisp clear air glinting with ice.
luz.atardecer: A low, pale sun sets behind the peaks, flushing the ice and snow pink and orange while the shadows turn deep blue.
luz.noche: Stars glitter over the ice under a soft, even pearly glow that lights the snow and glaciers, with deep blue shadows and frost glinting in the cold air.

estaciones.primavera: Meltwater runs in thin streams over the dark rock, the glaciers creak and shed blocks of ice into the sea, and the patches of snow shrink.
estaciones.verano: Bare dark rock shows through the thinned snow, the ice faces glint wet in long pale light and the sea cliffs echo with meltwater.
estaciones.otono: Fresh snow dusts the dark rock again, the first sea ice rims the shore and the air turns sharply clear.
estaciones.invierno: Deep snow buries the tundra and the rock, the glaciers are bound in thick blue ice, and the long cold holds everything still.

Ciénaga Troncal.paisaje: a dense swamp of tangled trunks and climbing vines, dark standing water and flat muddy clearings

luz.dia: Soft humid light filtered green through the canopy, with a warm haze rising off the water.
luz.atardecer: Low amber light slants through the canopy and turns the haze rising off the water gold, while the dark water mirrors a warm sky.
luz.noche: Stars show through gaps in the canopy, a soft pearly glow gleams on the dark water and a pale haze hangs low over it.

estaciones.primavera: Rising water floods the muddy clearings, new vines climb the trunks and the swamp is loud with life.
estaciones.verano: The water has shrunk to dark pools between cracked mud flats, and a heavy humid heat sits under the canopy.
estaciones.otono: Leaves and bark fall into the water and carpet it in dull russet, while fruit hangs heavy on the vines.
estaciones.invierno: A cold grey mist lies over the still water, the vines hang bare and the clearings are hard with chilled mud.

Margen Silencioso.paisaje: a temperate rainforest of black-wooded conifers and dense dark foliage over marshy ground, the air clear and perfectly still

luz.dia: Dim green light under a thick canopy is pierced by a few sharp shafts of sun.
luz.atardecer: Low amber light slants between the black trunks in a few warm shafts, while the canopy above stays dim and green.
luz.noche: Deep cool darkness fills the space under the canopy, with stars glimpsed through gaps in the branches and a soft pearly glow on the wet leaves.

estaciones.primavera: Pale new needles tip the black branches, the marshy ground is soaked with meltwater and ferns uncurl in the still air.
estaciones.verano: The conifers stand dense and dark, the marshy ground has firmed up and the still air is warm and heavy with resin.
estaciones.otono: Rust-brown needles drift down onto the dark marsh and mushrooms crowd the roots.
estaciones.invierno: Frost rimes the black bark and the edges of the marsh are crusted with ice, while the canopy stays dark and still.

Meseta del Orden.paisaje: a grey stone desert of flat slabs and stepped terraces laid out with unnatural symmetry, sparse iron-grey grass, distant fortress walls of polished stone and black iron

luz.dia: Harsh high sun on grey stone, crisp hard shadows and a clear pale sky.
luz.atardecer: A low sun reddens the grey stone and lays long hard shadows from the terraces and walls under an amber sky.
luz.noche: Stars fill a clear sky over the grey stone, a soft, even pearly glow outlines the slabs and terraces, and the shadows are hard and cold.

estaciones.primavera: A thin film of green creeps along the cracks of the grey slabs after the rains.
estaciones.verano: Heat shimmers over the grey slabs and the iron-grey grass is dry and brittle.
estaciones.otono: A dry wind drives grey dust across the terraces and the sparse grass turns dull brown.
estaciones.invierno: The cold grey stone is rimed with white frost, the grass lies flat and stiff, and the sky is pale and hard.

fondo._nota: Segunda pasada (D10): la zona aprobada va como -r; el prompt solo describe al sujeto y pide respetar la escena.
fondo.entrada: In this {lugar}, keep the scenery, sky and light exactly as they are, and place in the foreground
fondo.cierre: It matches the {estilo} style and the light of the scene.

coherencia._nota: IMG-14: el prompt final tiene que casar con su momento (regla 9). Patrones sobre el prompt completo, tras recortar.

vetadas.motivo: «crystal dust across the heavens» pinta estrellas de día
vetadas.alternativa: «a light warm haze» de día; el velo perlado solo en el preámbulo de noche

vetadas.motivo: las «vetas de arena fosilizada» salen como cortes rosados
